offering_description.value: Expeditors arranges freight transport and provides warehousing, distribution, and customs support for businesses. It coordinates shipments through a global network of locations and uses technology to help customers book shipments, track cargo, and manage inventory.

At Expeditors, we generate highly optimized and customized supply chain solutions for our clients through unified technology systems integrated across a global network of multiple locations in multiple countries on six continents.
